# Innovation Built Around Real Healthcare Needs

AliMed has always been shaped by a simple idea: better solutions start with understanding the
everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

# Amedisys Home Health Care Services

Home Health Care

Skilled nursing and therapy to help you recover from illness, injury or surgery, or to manage
long-term conditions.

[Start Support ][107]

Hospice Care

Physical, emotional and spiritual care at the end of life, along with help for loved ones.

[Find Comfort ][108]

Palliative Care

Relief from pain and symptoms to help improve quality of life at any stage of a serious illness.

[Find Relief ][109]

Hospital-Level and Skilled Nursing Care at Home

Contessa, an Amedisys company, enables a new standard of care with provider partners and payors.

## Standard Ground Shipping

**Most items** are processed within 24 hours and are shipped from the warehouse within 48 hours via
3-7 business day ground delivery service (unless lead-time is otherwise noted on the product page).
Free ground shipping only applies to the 48 contiguous United States. Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico
and all international orders are subject to additional fees. Orders placed over the weekend will be
processed first thing Monday morning. We will attempt to notify you by email and provide a tracking
# when your product(s) ship.


## Freight Shipping (Truck Freight)

**Heavy items** (anything over 150 lbs), bulk-freight, and pallet truck items and custom fabrication
made-to-order items may have longer shipping lead times. Customer will be notified as soon as
Truck-Freight items become available for overland freight shipment across the 48 contiguous United
States. If you do not have a loading-dock, be sure to choose lift-gate as your delivery option when
purchasing an overland-freight truck item. Free Freight Shipping, when applicable, only applies to
the 48 contiguous United States. Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico and all international orders are
subject to additional fees.

The Bisley Group is a multinational marketer
and distributor of quality industrial raw materials focused on Australia, New Zealand, Asia,
the Middle East and North America.

[Get In Touch][24]

# Suppliers of Raw Materials, Chemicals, Industrial Minerals & Additives

### [Agrichemicals][25]

Bisley is an important supplier of trace elements and additives for the fertiliser industry.

### [Aluminium][26]

Bisley has been a trusted supplier of raw materials to the Aluminium industry since the 1950’s.

### [Steel][27]

Bisley supplies bulk and specialty alloys, carbon products and other consumables for Steel.

### [Construction & Building Materials][28]

Bisley is a major supplier of raw materials for concrete admixtures, high performance concrete,
drymix and plasterboard.

### [Food & Beverages][29]

Bisley provides a range of specialty ingrediants for Food & Beverage applications.

### [Grease & Lubricants][30]

Bisley & Company have serviced the Lubricant/Grease industry for over 25 years. 

### [Industrial Chemicals & Minerals][31]

The Bisley group is active in a wide range of chemicals encompassing many end uses.

### [Paints & Coatings][32]

The Bisley group has extensive experience supplying the paints and coatings industries.

### [Refractory][33]

We are a leading supplier of industrial minerals, chemicals, and additives for the Refractory
sector.

### [Foundry][34]

Bisley supplies a comprehensive range of alloys and additives for the Foundry sector.

### [Oil Well Drilling][35]

Bisley have a range of innovative products for drilling, extraction & cementing of wells.

### [Water Treatment][36]

We supply chemicals for industrial and municipal water treatment, chlorination of swimming pools and
spas, and fluoridation of drinking water.

### [Clean Air Solutions][37]

Bisley represents Solvay, a market leading European company providing high performing Clean Air
Solutions.

9

#### What We Do

Bisley deploys a holistic understanding of markets, technical insight and logistics excellence to
build durable strategies which unite the world’s best raw material producers with industrial
consumers in Australia/New Zealand, Asia, the Middle East and North America.

Behind every major project are people most of us never see. The engineers, technicians, project
leaders and technical specialists powering the electricity in our homes, the materials we depend on,
the infrastructure that connects us, and the essential industries we depend on every day.


For over[50 years][48], Brunel has helped the world's leading businesses find and mobilise
specialist talent for some of the most critical projects and industries on the planet, wherever, and
whenever, they're needed.

Whether you're delivering a major project, scaling operations across borders, or solving your next
workforce challenge, our global recruitment specialists are here to help you find the people who
make it possible.

Blood Glucose Monitoring
Blood glucose monitoring is a critical process for managing diabetes, involving the regular
measurement of blood sugar levels to ensure they remain within a target range. This helps in making
informed decisions about diet, exercise, and medication to maintain optimal health and prevent
complications.
Canes and Crutches
Canes and crutches are essential mobility aids that provide support and stability to individuals
with walking difficulties or injuries. Canes offer lightweight assistance for balance, while
crutches distribute weight from the legs to the upper body, aiding in movement for those with more
significant mobility challenges.
Surgical Dressing
Surgical dressings are sterile coverings applied to wounds after surgical procedures to protect
against infection, absorb exudate, and promote healing. These dressings come in various forms,
including gauze, films, foams, and hydrocolloids, each designed to cater to specific wound care
needs and optimize recovery.

Home Oxygen, CPAP /BIPAP machines, Hospital Beds, Walkers, Power scooters, Power Wheelchairs, and
much more. We sell supplies and products which are used as a treatment or mobility aid during an
individual’s recovery due to illness or injury or to improve or maintain an independent living at an
advanced age.

We are not limited to one region only. We Provide our products throughout the united states.

[Luxurious Modern Medi-Spa Treatment Room][107]
Luxurious Modern Medi-Spa Treatment Room This sophisticated treatment room features two premium
electric medical spa chairs in matte black. Engineered for high-end clinics, these chairs deliver
multi-zone automated precision via wired controllers, ensuring seamless adjustment and exceptional
ergonomic patient comfort. The minimalist interior radiates a refined, upscale atmosphere. Dark

thoughtfully curated space perfectly bridges cutting-edge clinical utility with a serene, luxurious
guest experience.
[[Delivering Perfection Across Borders – When Premium Design Meets Elegant Aesthetics]][108]
[Delivering Perfection Across Borders – When Premium Design Meets Elegant Aesthetics][109]
There is nothing more rewarding than seeing our products perfectly integrated into our clients'
beautiful spaces. Recently, one of our valued international clients shared this stunning image of
their newly arrived electric beauty beds, freshly set up in their high-end aesthetic clinic. The
result is absolutely breathtaking. As shown in the photograph, the sleek, minimalist cream-white
contours of our premium beauty beds effortlessly complement the warm, sophisticated interior design
of the salon. The seamless harmony between the modern furniture and the elegant vanity lighting
creates an atmosphere of pure luxury, comfort, and professionalism. It is a perfect testament to how
the right equipment can elevate an entire business environment. Our beauty beds are engineered not
just for exceptional functionality and durability, but also as a key visual anchor for modern
wellness centers, spas, and clinics worldwide. Featuring ergonomic support, smooth multi-angle
adjustments, and premium, easy-to-clean upholstery, they ensure that both the aesthetician and the
client enjoy an unparalleled experience. We take immense pride in delivering top-tier quality that
transcends borders. This feedback from our global client reaffirms our commitment to excellence,
demonstrating that our commitment to craftsmanship truly resonates on an international scale. We are
thrilled to play a part in helping our clients create beautiful, high-performing spaces that leave a
lasting impression on their guests. Thank you to our amazing partners worldwide for choosing us to
elevate your business!
[[When Our Chairs Meet Their New Home: A Moment of Pride]][110]
[When Our Chairs Meet Their New Home: A Moment of Pride][111]
Today, I’m absolutely over the moon. I just received these stunning photos from one of our overseas
clients, showing our 4 electric beauty chairs set up in their brand-new salon—and I had to share
this feeling with all of you. Take a look at how they shine in this elegant, modern space. There’s
nothing more rewarding than seeing the furniture we pour our hearts into transform a salon into a
luxurious, welcoming haven for clients and technicians alike. This is exactly why we do what we do.
At our factory, we believe a beauty chair is more than just a piece of furniture—it’s the
centerpiece of your service, the foundation of your client’s comfort, and a tool that makes your
team’s job easier. That’s why every detail of these chairs is built for performance, luxury, and
ease of use. Let me break down what makes these chairs so special, and why they’re the perfect
upgrade for any professional salon: **Powerful Electric Functionality, Effortless Control Forget
struggling with manual levers mid-treatment. These chairs are fully electric, powered by quiet,
reliable motors that let you adjust height, backrest angle, and leg rest position with the touch of
a button. Whether you’re doing facials, pedicures, massages, or medical aesthetic treatments, you
can instantly position the chair to the perfect angle for your client’s comfort and your ergonomic
working posture. No more awkward reaching or straining—just smooth, precise adjustments every time.
**Multi-Functional Design for Every Service These chairs are true workhorses, built to handle every
service your salon offers. The adjustable headrest, flip-up armrests, and extendable leg sections
mean you can seamlessly switch between services. Need a fully reclined position for a facial? Or an
upright, elevated position for a pedicure? These chairs adapt to your needs, not the other way
around. The high-density foam padding and premium faux leather upholstery ensure clients stay
comfortable even during the longest treatments, while being easy to wipe down and sanitize between
guests. **Foot Control: Hands-Free Convenience for Busy Salons Here’s a game-changer for busy
technicians: the built-in foot control panel. When your hands are busy with products, tools, or your
client, you don’t need to reach for the remote. Just tap the foot controls to adjust height or
tilt—keeping your workflow smooth, hygienic, and uninterrupted. It’s a small feature that makes a
huge difference in daily salon efficiency, letting you focus on what matters most: your client.
Seeing these chairs come to life in our client’s salon fills me with so much pride. Every stitch,
every motor, every detail is designed to help beauty professionals like you elevate your space and
your services. If you’re looking to upgrade your salon with furniture that’s as functional as it is
beautiful, we’d love to help you create a space your clients will never want to leave.
[[Facial beds for Fical treatment]][112]
[Facial beds for Fical treatment][113]
A facial bed, also known as aesthetician bed or beauty bed, is a specialized piece of furniture used
in beauty salons, spas, and esthetician clinics for facial treatments and skincare procedures. It is
designed to provide a comfortable and convenient platform for clients to lie down during their
facial services. Facial beds typically have a padded surface with a face cradle or a headrest for
clients to rest their face comfortably. The bed's height is adjustable to allow estheticians to work
at an appropriate level and provide easy access to the client's face. Some facial beds may also have
an adjustable backrest, allowing clients to sit up partially during certain treatments. These beds
often feature ergonomic designs to ensure client comfort and support. The materials used in their
construction are typically durable and easy to clean, such as leatherette or vinyl upholstery. The
bed may also have storage compartments or drawers for estheticians to keep their tools and supplies

[[Luxurious Modern Medi-Spa Treatment Room]][106]
[Luxurious Modern Medi-Spa Treatment Room][107]
Luxurious Modern Medi-Spa Treatment Room This sophisticated treatment room features two premium
electric medical spa chairs in matte black. Engineered for high-end clinics, these chairs deliver
multi-zone automated precision via wired controllers, ensuring seamless adjustment and exceptional
ergonomic patient comfort. The minimalist interior radiates a refined, upscale atmosphere. Dark
terrazzo flooring mirrors the warm, ambient glow of recessed LED strip lights. The background blends
seamless glass display cabinets with rich wood paneling and textured charcoal walls. This
thoughtfully curated space perfectly bridges cutting-edge clinical utility with a serene, luxurious
guest experience.
[[Delivering Perfection Across Borders – When Premium Design Meets Elegant Aesthetics]][108]
[Delivering Perfection Across Borders – When Premium Design Meets Elegant Aesthetics][109]
There is nothing more rewarding than seeing our products perfectly integrated into our clients'
beautiful spaces. Recently, one of our valued international clients shared this stunning image of
their newly arrived electric beauty beds, freshly set up in their high-end aesthetic clinic. The
result is absolutely breathtaking. As shown in the photograph, the sleek, minimalist cream-white
contours of our premium beauty beds effortlessly complement the warm, sophisticated interior design
of the salon. The seamless harmony between the modern furniture and the elegant vanity lighting
creates an atmosphere of pure luxury, comfort, and professionalism. It is a perfect testament to how
the right equipment can elevate an entire business environment. Our beauty beds are engineered not
just for exceptional functionality and durability, but also as a key visual anchor for modern
wellness centers, spas, and clinics worldwide. Featuring ergonomic support, smooth multi-angle
adjustments, and premium, easy-to-clean upholstery, they ensure that both the aesthetician and the
client enjoy an unparalleled experience. We take immense pride in delivering top-tier quality that
transcends borders. This feedback from our global client reaffirms our commitment to excellence,
demonstrating that our commitment to craftsmanship truly resonates on an international scale. We are
thrilled to play a part in helping our clients create beautiful, high-performing spaces that leave a
lasting impression on their guests. Thank you to our amazing partners worldwide for choosing us to
elevate your business!
[[When Our Chairs Meet Their New Home: A Moment of Pride]][110]
[When Our Chairs Meet Their New Home: A Moment of Pride][111]
Today, I’m absolutely over the moon. I just received these stunning photos from one of our overseas
clients, showing our 4 electric beauty chairs set up in their brand-new salon—and I had to share
this feeling with all of you. Take a look at how they shine in this elegant, modern space. There’s
nothing more rewarding than seeing the furniture we pour our hearts into transform a salon into a
luxurious, welcoming haven for clients and technicians alike. This is exactly why we do what we do.
At our factory, we believe a beauty chair is more than just a piece of furniture—it’s the
centerpiece of your service, the foundation of your client’s comfort, and a tool that makes your
team’s job easier. That’s why every detail of these chairs is built for performance, luxury, and
ease of use. Let me break down what makes these chairs so special, and why they’re the perfect
upgrade for any professional salon: **Powerful Electric Functionality, Effortless Control Forget
struggling with manual levers mid-treatment. These chairs are fully electric, powered by quiet,
reliable motors that let you adjust height, backrest angle, and leg rest position with the touch of
a button. Whether you’re doing facials, pedicures, massages, or medical aesthetic treatments, you
can instantly position the chair to the perfect angle for your client’s comfort and your ergonomic
working posture. No more awkward reaching or straining—just smooth, precise adjustments every time.
**Multi-Functional Design for Every Service These chairs are true workhorses, built to handle every
service your salon offers. The adjustable headrest, flip-up armrests, and extendable leg sections
mean you can seamlessly switch between services. Need a fully reclined position for a facial? Or an
upright, elevated position for a pedicure? These chairs adapt to your needs, not the other way
around. The high-density foam padding and premium faux leather upholstery ensure clients stay
comfortable even during the longest treatments, while being easy to wipe down and sanitize between
guests. **Foot Control: Hands-Free Convenience for Busy Salons Here’s a game-changer for busy
technicians: the built-in foot control panel. When your hands are busy with products, tools, or your
client, you don’t need to reach for the remote. Just tap the foot controls to adjust height or
tilt—keeping your workflow smooth, hygienic, and uninterrupted. It’s a small feature that makes a
huge difference in daily salon efficiency, letting you focus on what matters most: your client.
Seeing these chairs come to life in our client’s salon fills me with so much pride. Every stitch,
every motor, every detail is designed to help beauty professionals like you elevate your space and
your services. If you’re looking to upgrade your salon with furniture that’s as functional as it is
beautiful, we’d love to help you create a space your clients will never want to leave.
[[Facial beds for Fical treatment]][112]
[Facial beds for Fical treatment][113]
A facial bed, also known as aesthetician bed or beauty bed, is a specialized piece of furniture used
in beauty salons, spas, and esthetician clinics for facial treatments and skincare procedures. It is
designed to provide a comfortable and convenient platform for clients to lie down during their
facial services. Facial beds typically have a padded surface with a face cradle or a headrest for
clients to rest their face comfortably. The bed's height is adjustable to allow estheticians to work
at an appropriate level and provide easy access to the client's face. Some facial beds may also have
an adjustable backrest, allowing clients to sit up partially during certain treatments. These beds
often feature ergonomic designs to ensure client comfort and support. The materials used in their
construction are typically durable and easy to clean, such as leatherette or vinyl upholstery. The
bed may also have storage compartments or drawers for estheticians to keep their tools and supplies
conveniently accessible. Additionally, some facial beds come with additional features or attachments
to enhance the treatment experience. These may include adjustable lighting, built-in magnifying
lamps, armrests, and even built-in massage functions in more advanced models. Overall, facial beds
are essential equipment in beauty establishments, providing a comfortable and relaxed position for
clients to receive various facial treatments and allow estheticians to perform their services
efficiently and effectively. It's the time to highly recommend HC-B006 set Electric Beauty Bed. It's

## About Us

#### Focus on medical respiratory and rehabilitation equipment production with more than 20 years
#### experience

Jiangsu Jumao X-Care Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is situated in the Danyang Phoenix Industrial Zone,
Jiangsu Province. Established in 2002, the company boasts a fixed asset investment of 200 million
yuan, spanning an area of 90,000 square meters. We proudly employ over 450 dedicated staff members,
including more than 80 professional and technical personnel. Specializing in the production of
wheelchairs, rollators, oxygen concentrators, patient beds, and other rehabilitation and health care
products, our company is equipped with advanced production and testing facilities. Our commitment to
innovation is evident through our professional R&D teams located in China and Ohio, USA, positioning
us as an industry leader. Many governments and foundations have designated our products for their
medical institutions, reflecting our excellence and reliability.

We foster a spirit of “unity, progress, pragmatism, and efficiency,” building a team renowned for
its effective execution. Our unwavering commitment to quality control ensures that we consistently
uphold our principles of “thorough development, quality-production, customer-trust.” We prioritize
“quality first, reputation first,” aiming to create a bright future in collaboration with our
customers through high-quality, stable, and safe products. Our dedication to quality is demonstrated
by our numerous certifications: ISO 9001: 2015 and IS013485: 2016 quality system certifications;
ISO14001: 2004 environmental system certification, FDA 510 (k) certification for our wheelchairs and
oxygen concentrators in the United States, ETL certification and CE certification for our oxygen
concentrators

We have invested significantly in new product research and development, securing many patents. Our
state-of-the-art facilities include large plastic injection machines, automatic bending machines,
welding robots, automatic wire wheel shaping machines, and other specialized production and testing
equipment. Our integrated manufacturing capabilities encompass precision machining and metal surface
treatment. Our production infrastructure features two advanced automatic spraying production lines
and eight assembly lines, with an impressive annual production capacity of 600,000 pieces.

As we look to the future, we are committed to striving to provide exceptional customer service and
contribute value to society as “JUMAO”. We aim to create new frontiers in the medical industry, hand
in hand with our partners and customers. Join us as we continue to innovate and lead in the field of
medical equipment, dedicated to improving lives and advancing healthcare solutions globally.

## About Us

#### Focus on medical respiratory and rehabilitation equipment production with more than 20 years
#### experience

Jiangsu Jumao X-Care Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is situated in the Danyang Phoenix Industrial Zone,
Jiangsu Province. Established in 2002, the company boasts a fixed asset investment of 200 million
yuan, spanning an area of 90,000 square meters. We proudly employ over 450 dedicated staff members,
including more than 80 professional and technical personnel. Specializing in the production of
wheelchairs, rollators, oxygen concentrators, patient beds, and other rehabilitation and health care
products, our company is equipped with advanced production and testing facilities. Our commitment to
innovation is evident through our professional R&D teams located in China and Ohio, USA, positioning
us as an industry leader. Many governments and foundations have designated our products for their
medical institutions, reflecting our excellence and reliability.

We foster a spirit of “unity, progress, pragmatism, and efficiency,” building a team renowned for
its effective execution. Our unwavering commitment to quality control ensures that we consistently
uphold our principles of “thorough development, quality-production, customer-trust.” We prioritize
“quality first, reputation first,” aiming to create a bright future in collaboration with our
customers through high-quality, stable, and safe products. Our dedication to quality is demonstrated
by our numerous certifications: ISO 9001: 2015 and IS013485: 2016 quality system certifications;
ISO14001: 2004 environmental system certification, FDA 510 (k) certification for our wheelchairs and
oxygen concentrators in the United States, ETL certification and CE certification for our oxygen
concentrators

We have invested significantly in new product research and development, securing many patents. Our
state-of-the-art facilities include large plastic injection machines, automatic bending machines,
welding robots, automatic wire wheel shaping machines, and other specialized production and testing
equipment. Our integrated manufacturing capabilities encompass precision machining and metal surface
treatment. Our production infrastructure features two advanced automatic spraying production lines
and eight assembly lines, with an impressive annual production capacity of 600,000 pieces.

As we look to the future, we are committed to striving to provide exceptional customer service and
contribute value to society as “JUMAO”. We aim to create new frontiers in the medical industry, hand
in hand with our partners and customers. Join us as we continue to innovate and lead in the field of
medical equipment, dedicated to improving lives and advancing healthcare solutions globally.

[More][58]

## Providing Solutions in Home Health Care for 25 + Years

Welcome to MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution, your community partner in home health care, assisted
living, retirement, and long-term care. When you need a wheelchair, a barrier-free bathtub, or even
physiotherapy equipment, you want assurance that your needs will be met by knowledgeable experts who
care about your independence and dignity. That’s where we come in! MED+ Home Health Care has worked
in your community for twenty five years to ensure that all community members maintain as much
mobility and independence as possible. So whether you choose to remain at home or move to one of
Ontario’s excellent long term care homes, you can buy or rent any custom medical equipment and
personal supplies that meet your needs.

We provide personal service, working with you and your caregivers through the entire process from
ordering, overnight delivery, through to custom fitting or training in the use of the products. Need
advice or help renovating your home to be wheelchair accessible or to ensure fall prevention? Want
to browse at your leisure through a store that displays the products you need? Or how about getting
help with that physiotherapy? MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution is here to help with all these
situations and more!

## [Stairlifts][75]

MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution has access to a large selection of stair lift products for your
home. We have custom stair lift solutions that can help you improve safety, mobility, and make it
easier to get up and down stairs inside or outside your home. Whether you are looking for a basic
stair lift, a unit for a curved staircase, or even a lift for stairs outdoors, we can help!

[Learn More][76]
[[Stairlifts]][77] [Learn More][78]

## WE ARE COMMITTED TO HELPING YOU STAY IN THE HOME YOU LOVE

Whether you are ageing or recovering from an injury, maintaining your independence is important to
you. For MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution it means a lot to us as well. We recognize your need to
have control over your life. We help you do this by providing medical equipment and products that
helps you maintain as much independence and comfort as you can, whatever your circumstances.

[Learn More][79]

### MED+ Is Proud to Be a Project Partner with Mike Holmes

As seen on Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy, MED+ is proud to partner with the Holmes family to
highlight the importance of accessibility and aging in place. Together, we showcased innovative
solutions, such as custom stairlifts and barrier-free designs, that make homes safe, functional, and
inclusive for people of all abilities. This collaboration underscores our shared mission to empower
Canadians with independence and dignity, creating spaces that truly work for everyone.

## Providing Solutions in Home Health Care for 25 + Years

Welcome to MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution, your community partner in home health care, assisted
living, retirement, and long-term care. When you need a wheelchair, a barrier-free bathtub, or even
physiotherapy equipment, you want assurance that your needs will be met by knowledgeable experts who
care about your independence and dignity. That’s where we come in! MED+ Home Health Care has worked
in your community for twenty five years to ensure that all community members maintain as much
mobility and independence as possible. So whether you choose to remain at home or move to one of
Ontario’s excellent long term care homes, you can buy or rent any custom medical equipment and
personal supplies that meet your needs.

We provide personal service, working with you and your caregivers through the entire process from
ordering, overnight delivery, through to custom fitting or training in the use of the products. Need
advice or help renovating your home to be wheelchair accessible or to ensure fall prevention? Want
to browse at your leisure through a store that displays the products you need? Or how about getting
help with that physiotherapy? MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution is here to help with all these
situations and more!

## [Stairlifts][75]

MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution has access to a large selection of stair lift products for your
home. We have custom stair lift solutions that can help you improve safety, mobility, and make it
easier to get up and down stairs inside or outside your home. Whether you are looking for a basic
stair lift, a unit for a curved staircase, or even a lift for stairs outdoors, we can help!

[Learn More][76]
[[Stairlifts]][77] [Learn More][78]

## WE ARE COMMITTED TO HELPING YOU STAY IN THE HOME YOU LOVE

Whether you are ageing or recovering from an injury, maintaining your independence is important to
you. For MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution it means a lot to us as well. We recognize your need to
have control over your life. We help you do this by providing medical equipment and products that
helps you maintain as much independence and comfort as you can, whatever your circumstances.

[Learn More][79]

### MED+ Is Proud to Be a Project Partner with Mike Holmes

As seen on Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy, MED+ is proud to partner with the Holmes family to
highlight the importance of accessibility and aging in place. Together, we showcased innovative
solutions, such as custom stairlifts and barrier-free designs, that make homes safe, functional, and
inclusive for people of all abilities. This collaboration underscores our shared mission to empower
Canadians with independence and dignity, creating spaces that truly work for everyone.

## Canes and Crutches

CRUTCHES, FOREARM, INCLUDES CRUTCHES OF VARIOUS MATERIALS, ADJUSTABLE OR FIXED, PAIR, COMPLETE WITH
TIPS AND HANDGRIPS. Canes, crutches, and walkers improve balance, assist walking, reduce load on the
lower limbs, transmit sensory cues, and enable maneuvering in places inaccessible to a wheelchair.
Assistive devices are manufactured in many designs. Canes differ by material, handle shape, and
base. Crutches may have an axillary piece, a forearm cuff, or an upper arm support. Walkers can have
wheels or rubber tips. Correct measurement is essential with any assistive device. Gait patterns
used with assistive devices may be alternating (reciprocal), in which the user moves one foot at a
time, or swinging (simultaneous), with patient moving both feet at the same time. Kinetic analyses

## Canes and Crutches

CRUTCHES, FOREARM, INCLUDES CRUTCHES OF VARIOUS MATERIALS, ADJUSTABLE OR FIXED, PAIR, COMPLETE WITH
TIPS AND HANDGRIPS. Canes, crutches, and walkers improve balance, assist walking, reduce load on the
lower limbs, transmit sensory cues, and enable maneuvering in places inaccessible to a wheelchair.
Assistive devices are manufactured in many designs. Canes differ by material, handle shape, and
base. Crutches may have an axillary piece, a forearm cuff, or an upper arm support. Walkers can have
wheels or rubber tips. Correct measurement is essential with any assistive device. Gait patterns
used with assistive devices may be alternating (reciprocal), in which the user moves one foot at a
time, or swinging (simultaneous), with patient moving both feet at the same time. Kinetic analyses

# NCLEX-RN Tests: Practice Like It’s the Real Exam

Study smarter with authentic NCLEX-style questions organized by the **official NCLEX-RN Test Plan**.
Every item is mapped to the four Client Needs categories, so you always know where to focus—and how
your practice aligns with the real exam.
* **Distraction-free slideshow experience:** flip through questions in a clean, slide-by-slide
  format.
* **Reveal answers only when you’re ready:** tap the info icon—each solution is hidden in the image
  title to keep your thinking independent.
* **Fast, deep navigation:** start at the main category page and drill down to specific subtopics in
  seconds.
* **Always fresh. Always free.** New sets are added regularly—no paywalls, no limits.

### 50-Question Topic Tests (Hundreds of Sets per Subtopic)

Master content systematically with **50-question practice sets** in **every subcategory**. Build
momentum, track progress by topic, and revisit targeted areas as often as you like. With **hundreds
of tests** across subtopics—and more added over time—you’ll always have fresh material to work
through.

### 125-Question Full-Length Exams (Realistic and Balanced)

When you’re ready to simulate the real thing, switch to **125-question comprehensive exams** that
mirror the **official NCLEX-RN content distribution** across the four Client Needs categories:
* **Safe and Effective Care Environment** – Management of Care, Safety & Infection Control,
  Delegation & Prioritization, etc.
* **Health Promotion and Maintenance** – Growth & Development, Prenatal & Newborn Care, Screening &
  Disease Prevention, etc.
* **Psychosocial Integrity** – Coping Mechanisms, Mental Health Disorders, Crisis Intervention, etc.
* **Physiological Integrity** – Pharmacological & Parenteral Therapies, Basic Care & Comfort,
  Reduction of Risk Potential, Physiological Adaptation, etc.

Each full-length exam is **built from a separate, non-overlapping item pool**—so you won’t see
repeats from the 50-question sets—and each release is curated to be **distinct from prior full
exams**. The result: realistic pacing, authentic category balance, and a true confidence check
before test day.

**Choose a category, dive into the questions, and let consistent practice sharpen your clinical
judgment.** The more you work through them, the more second-nature NCLEX-style reasoning becomes.

# NCLEX Study Cards: Real Cards, Smart Structure

These are **authentic flashcards shared by real NCLEX candidates**—practical, exam-ready insights
rather than generic summaries. Cards are **organized by the official NCLEX test plan categories**,
so you can find exactly what you need.

**Effortless navigation:** start on the main category page and **click down to the deepest topic
level** in seconds—clean, fast, and easy to use on any device.

We **update this library continuously** with new cards and improvements. **Check back often** to
catch fresh additions and keep your prep sharp.

# NCLEX-RN Tests: Practice Like It’s the Real Exam

Study smarter with authentic NCLEX-style questions organized by the **official NCLEX-RN Test Plan**.
Every item is mapped to the four Client Needs categories, so you always know where to focus—and how
your practice aligns with the real exam.
* **Distraction-free slideshow experience:** flip through questions in a clean, slide-by-slide
  format.
* **Reveal answers only when you’re ready:** tap the info icon—each solution is hidden in the image
  title to keep your thinking independent.
* **Fast, deep navigation:** start at the main category page and drill down to specific subtopics in
  seconds.
* **Always fresh. Always free.** New sets are added regularly—no paywalls, no limits.

### 50-Question Topic Tests (Hundreds of Sets per Subtopic)

Master content systematically with **50-question practice sets** in **every subcategory**. Build
momentum, track progress by topic, and revisit targeted areas as often as you like. With **hundreds
of tests** across subtopics—and more added over time—you’ll always have fresh material to work
through.

### 125-Question Full-Length Exams (Realistic and Balanced)

When you’re ready to simulate the real thing, switch to **125-question comprehensive exams** that
mirror the **official NCLEX-RN content distribution** across the four Client Needs categories:
* **Safe and Effective Care Environment** – Management of Care, Safety & Infection Control,
  Delegation & Prioritization, etc.
* **Health Promotion and Maintenance** – Growth & Development, Prenatal & Newborn Care, Screening &
  Disease Prevention, etc.
* **Psychosocial Integrity** – Coping Mechanisms, Mental Health Disorders, Crisis Intervention, etc.
* **Physiological Integrity** – Pharmacological & Parenteral Therapies, Basic Care & Comfort,
  Reduction of Risk Potential, Physiological Adaptation, etc.

Each full-length exam is **built from a separate, non-overlapping item pool**—so you won’t see
repeats from the 50-question sets—and each release is curated to be **distinct from prior full
exams**. The result: realistic pacing, authentic category balance, and a true confidence check
before test day.

**Choose a category, dive into the questions, and let consistent practice sharpen your clinical
judgment.** The more you work through them, the more second-nature NCLEX-style reasoning becomes.

# NCLEX Study Cards: Real Cards, Smart Structure

These are **authentic flashcards shared by real NCLEX candidates**—practical, exam-ready insights
rather than generic summaries. Cards are **organized by the official NCLEX test plan categories**,
so you can find exactly what you need.

**Effortless navigation:** start on the main category page and **click down to the deepest topic
level** in seconds—clean, fast, and easy to use on any device.

We **update this library continuously** with new cards and improvements. **Check back often** to

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

About Palma Airport

Palma de Mallorca Airport (PMI), also known as Son Sant Joan Airport, is the gateway to the
wonderful island of Mallorca. It’s the place where most people begin and end their holiday. Palma
Airport is the **third-largest** airport in Spain, with close to** 34 million passengers every
year**, dispatching **more than 12,000 passengers per hour** during busy periods. In the peak summer
months, this dual-runway airport handles as many movements as Heathrow, the busiest airport in
Europe.

## About Us

Our Mission is to optimally enable persons with Locomotor Disabilities by quality interventions that
go beyond their medical needs and to provide him/her need based comprehensive rehabilitation through
team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic
independence, train Rehabilitation Professionals and undertake Research.

To actualize the potential of every person with locomotor disability and to ensure him/her equal
opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

## About Us

Our Mission is to optimally enable persons with Locomotor Disabilities by quality interventions that
go beyond their medical needs and to provide him/her need based comprehensive rehabilitation through
team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic
independence, train Rehabilitation Professionals and undertake Research.

To actualize the potential of every person with locomotor disability and to ensure him/her equal
opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

## About Us

Our Mission is to optimally enable persons with Locomotor Disabilities by quality interventions that
go beyond their medical needs and to provide him/her need based comprehensive rehabilitation through
team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic
independence, train Rehabilitation Professionals and undertake Research.

To actualize the potential of every person with locomotor disability and to ensure him/her equal
opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

## Template.net: The AI Production Engine FAQ

### What is Template.net?

Template.net is an **AI Production Engine** that transforms natural language prompts into
production-ready assets. We bridge the gap between AI inference (thinking) and professional
execution (doing). Our engine generates fully layered, editable, and branded outputs—including
documents, presentations, diagrams, charts, and functional web assets.

### What does “production-ready” mean in the AI era?

Most AI tools provide a "preview" or a "mockup." A **Production-Ready** output from
[Template.net][19] is:
* **Structurally Correct:** Built with professional hierarchies and logic.
* **Fully Editable:** No "AI walls"—every element can be modified.
* **Brand-Compliant:** Automatically synced to your brand identity.
* **Native-Exportable:** Ready for immediate use in PowerPoint, Word, Google Workspace, or Web
  Servers.

### How is Template.net different from Canva, Google Docs, or AI "Artifacts"?

Traditional tools focus on manual creation, while AI "Artifacts" (like those in Claude or ChatGPT)
are often trapped inside a chat window.
**Template.net focuses on Output Sovereignty.** We generate the "source code" of your work (Native
PPTX, HTML, SVG, DOCX, PDF) so your assets aren't locked in our platform—they belong to your
professional ecosystem.

### What specific assets can I produce?

From a single prompt, our all-in-one editor produces a vast ecosystem of professional assets:
* **Presentations:** Native, editable **PowerPoint (.pptx)** and **Google Slides**.
* **Documents:** Branded, professionally formatted business docs that export directly to **Microsoft
  Word (.docx), Google Docs, Notion, Zoho, and WordPress**.
* **Web & Email:** Clean, production-ready **HTML5, Embed Codes, and interactive SVG** assets for
  websites and newsletters.
* **Business Logic:** Functional **flowcharts, logic diagrams, and collaborative whiteboards**.
* **Data Viz:** Dynamic **charts and visual reports** driven by your data.
* **Visual Design:** High-fidelity graphics exported in **JPEG, PNG, Transparent SVG, WebP, GIF, and
  MP4 video**.
* **Utility Assets:** Custom **QR Codes** and interactive digital elements.

### Does Template.net support File Sovereignty?

Yes. Template.net is **not a walled garden.** We believe you should own your production. You can
export files in native formats—**PowerPoint (.pptx), Word (.docx), HTML, SVG, and PDF**—and continue
your workflow in any industry-standard software.

### Are the AI-generated outputs fully editable?

Yes. We provide **Atomic Editing**. Unlike AI tools that return flat images, our engine generates
discrete, layered components. You can modify text, adjust layouts, swap brand colors, and update
data structures within our AI-powered canvas.

### How does the engine handle Brand Consistency?

Our engine includes an integrated **Brand Kit**. By setting your brand rules once, every
AI-generated asset—from a complex project roadmap to a simple social graphic—is automatically
produced with your specific logos, fonts, color, brand profile and brand voice.

### Is there a friction-less entry (No-Signup)?

Yes. To empower high-velocity operators, Template.net offers a **No-Signup production flow**. You
can prompt, generate, and customize assets immediately. Signup is only required for advanced
features like team collaboration or high-capacity usage.

### Is Template.net free to use?

Yes. Free for Business, commercial and personal use. We offer a robust free tier for generation and
editing. Professional plans are available for users - advanced AI models, and enterprise-grade brand
management, teams, storage.

### How is user data handled for AI training?

We prioritize **Data Integrity**. User prompts and proprietary generated assets are **not** used to
train external AI models. Your business logic and brand data remain yours.

### Who is the "Production Engine" built for?

Template.net is designed for **Founders, Marketing Teams, HR Leads, and Operations Managers** who
prioritize **results over manual labor**. We serve anyone who needs to move from a thought to a
high-fidelity, usable file in seconds.

## Template.net: The AI Production Engine FAQ

### What is Template.net?

Template.net is an **AI Production Engine** that transforms natural language prompts into
production-ready assets. We bridge the gap between AI inference (thinking) and professional
execution (doing). Our engine generates fully layered, editable, and branded outputs—including
documents, presentations, diagrams, charts, and functional web assets.

### What does “production-ready” mean in the AI era?

Most AI tools provide a "preview" or a "mockup." A **Production-Ready** output from
[Template.net][19] is:
* **Structurally Correct:** Built with professional hierarchies and logic.
* **Fully Editable:** No "AI walls"—every element can be modified.
* **Brand-Compliant:** Automatically synced to your brand identity.
* **Native-Exportable:** Ready for immediate use in PowerPoint, Word, Google Workspace, or Web
  Servers.

### How is Template.net different from Canva, Google Docs, or AI "Artifacts"?

Traditional tools focus on manual creation, while AI "Artifacts" (like those in Claude or ChatGPT)
are often trapped inside a chat window.
**Template.net focuses on Output Sovereignty.** We generate the "source code" of your work (Native
PPTX, HTML, SVG, DOCX, PDF) so your assets aren't locked in our platform—they belong to your
professional ecosystem.

### What specific assets can I produce?

From a single prompt, our all-in-one editor produces a vast ecosystem of professional assets:
* **Presentations:** Native, editable **PowerPoint (.pptx)** and **Google Slides**.
* **Documents:** Branded, professionally formatted business docs that export directly to **Microsoft
  Word (.docx), Google Docs, Notion, Zoho, and WordPress**.
* **Web & Email:** Clean, production-ready **HTML5, Embed Codes, and interactive SVG** assets for
  websites and newsletters.
* **Business Logic:** Functional **flowcharts, logic diagrams, and collaborative whiteboards**.
* **Data Viz:** Dynamic **charts and visual reports** driven by your data.
* **Visual Design:** High-fidelity graphics exported in **JPEG, PNG, Transparent SVG, WebP, GIF, and
  MP4 video**.
* **Utility Assets:** Custom **QR Codes** and interactive digital elements.

### Does Template.net support File Sovereignty?

Yes. Template.net is **not a walled garden.** We believe you should own your production. You can
export files in native formats—**PowerPoint (.pptx), Word (.docx), HTML, SVG, and PDF**—and continue
your workflow in any industry-standard software.

### Are the AI-generated outputs fully editable?

Yes. We provide **Atomic Editing**. Unlike AI tools that return flat images, our engine generates
discrete, layered components. You can modify text, adjust layouts, swap brand colors, and update
data structures within our AI-powered canvas.

### How does the engine handle Brand Consistency?

Our engine includes an integrated **Brand Kit**. By setting your brand rules once, every
AI-generated asset—from a complex project roadmap to a simple social graphic—is automatically
produced with your specific logos, fonts, color, brand profile and brand voice.

### Is there a friction-less entry (No-Signup)?

Yes. To empower high-velocity operators, Template.net offers a **No-Signup production flow**. You
can prompt, generate, and customize assets immediately. Signup is only required for advanced
features like team collaboration or high-capacity usage.

### Is Template.net free to use?

Yes. Free for Business, commercial and personal use. We offer a robust free tier for generation and
editing. Professional plans are available for users - advanced AI models, and enterprise-grade brand
management, teams, storage.

### How is user data handled for AI training?

We prioritize **Data Integrity**. User prompts and proprietary generated assets are **not** used to
train external AI models. Your business logic and brand data remain yours.

### Who is the "Production Engine" built for?

Template.net is designed for **Founders, Marketing Teams, HR Leads, and Operations Managers** who
prioritize **results over manual labor**. We serve anyone who needs to move from a thought to a
high-fidelity, usable file in seconds.

## Product Category


[[Manual Wheelchair]][178]
[Manual Wheelchair][179]

Manual wheelchair‌ is a human-propelled wheelchair vehicle, mainly used to help people with limited

## FAQ

Q1: What certifications do your products hold?

Our rehabilitation equipment holds [**CE, FDA, and UKCA certifications**][49]. We operate under
an **ISO 13485 certified quality management system**, ensuring compliance for medical device markets
worldwide.

Q2: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

Standard product MOQ is **500 units per model**. For **custom OEM/ODM projects**, we accept orders
starting at **300 units**. New partners may discuss sample or trial orders for evaluation.

Q3: What are your lead times?

Standard orders ship within **15-20 business days**. Customized projects typically require **25-30
days** from confirmed design to shipment. We maintain reliable scheduling through our vertically
integrated 7,000㎡ manufacturing facility.

Q4: What customization options do you offer?

We provide full **OEM and ODM support**, including custom **colors, packaging, sizing, and private
labeling**. Our engineering team adapts products to meet regional regulations and user preferences
across 20+ countries.

Q5: What is your production capacity?

We maintain a **monthly production capacity of [50,000+ units][50]** with strict quality control at
every stage. Each product undergoes **multi-point inspection** including load testing, stability
verification, and safety compliance checks.

Q6: Do you support private labeling?

Yes. We offer complete **private label and white-label solutions** with no additional minimums for
branding application. Many distributors worldwide market our products under their own brand names.
